option.label: True ligule cilia may reach7 mm
option.detail: Measure actual hairs of the inner ligule, not a membranous base, collar hairs or culm-node beard. Gould gives a maximum hair length, not a7-mm membrane or lower endpoint.

option.label: Fingerlike branches erect to arching
option.detail: Gould gives usually3–6 (occasionally2–9) digitate branches4–14 cm, erect to arcuate. Curved branches do not establish a bent lemma awn.

option.label: Outer glumes hairless except rough midnerve
option.detail: Inspect the OUTER glumes. Scabrous midnerve is roughness, not ordinary stiff hairs or the dense hairs of the inner fertile lemma keel.

option.label: Outer glume margins thin and translucent
option.detail: Gould describes hyaline glume margins. Do not transfer this state to sheath margins, a ligule or the sterile florets.

option.label: LOWER fertile lemma flattened, narrow-ovate, hairy keel
option.detail: Gould describes the lower fertile lemma with densely ciliate keel and2.4–5.5 mm awn. Keep the leaflet-like outer glumes and sterile florets separate.

option.label: Two or three STERILE florets above fertile floret
option.detail: These are sterile florets ABOVE the one fertile lower floret:3–4 total in Gould, not two total. Broader modern accounts remain separately recorded.

option.label: Sterile florets top-shaped, flattened and hairless
option.detail: Inspect the upper sterile florets; Gould calls them turbinate, flattened, glabrous,1.1–1.8 mm. This does not describe the densely hairy fertile lemma keel.

option.label: LOWEST sterile floret awn1.5–3.5 mm
option.detail: Find the lowest of the sterile florets ABOVE the fertile floret. Its awn is not the fertile lemma’s2.4–5.5 mm awn, and not an arbitrary lower sterile lemma of another grass.

option.label: Upper sterile florets smaller and enclosed by lower
option.detail: Gould describes the upper sterile floret or florets as similar but smaller, enclosed by the lowermost sterile floret. Do not count the enclosing glumes as florets.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Find the true inner ligule and separate hairs from membrane
learner_diagnostic_checks.check: Gould describes long cilia with hairs to7 mm, not a7-mm membranous flap. The already admitted membrane state and regional/supplemental descriptions remain; no new minimum hair height or membrane length is invented.
learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: Long ligule hairs are not automatically the blade-base or culm-node hairs used in KR observations.

learner_diagnostic_checks.look: Measure the fertile awn and then the lowest sterile awn
learner_diagnostic_checks.check: The LOWER fertile lemma bears2.4–5.5 mm awn. Above it are2–3 sterile florets; the lowest sterile awn is1.5–3.5 mm, upper sterile florets smaller and enclosed by lower. Sterile bodies are hairless while fertile keel densely ciliate.
learner_diagnostic_checks.compare: Do not score a sterile awn as a fertile1–1.5 mm awn or count only fertile florets. Source floret counts differ and remain recorded.
